title: Contact Hub plugin API: errors
description: JSON-RPC error objects carry a numeric code and a string data.code; the mapping is fixed for known codes and both are open to values added by later minor versions. See docs/plugin-api.md section 13.

KnownErrorCode.description: The string error codes this version of the API defines, in table order (section 13).

ErrorCode.description: The string error code in error.data.code. Open: a code this version does not know (added by a later minor version) still validates; receivers treat it as INTERNAL and keep the string for logs. Emitters only use KnownErrorCode values.

KnownNumericCode.description: The JSON-RPC numeric codes this version defines. Fixed mapping: PARSE_ERROR -32700, INVALID_REQUEST -32600, METHOD_NOT_FOUND -32601, INVALID_PARAMS -32602, INTERNAL -32603, CANCELLED -32800, NOT_SUPPORTED -32001, AUTH_REQUIRED -32002, FLOOD_WAIT -32003, NOT_FOUND -32004, FORBIDDEN -32005, NETWORK -32006, TIMEOUT -32007, UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT -32008, UNAVAILABLE -32009.

NumericCode.description: The JSON-RPC numeric code. Open like ErrorCode: an unknown integer validates and is treated as INTERNAL unless data.code is known (data.code is authoritative).

seconds.description: FLOOD_WAIT: how long to wait before retrying.

capability.description: NOT_SUPPORTED: the capability that would be needed.

field.description: INVALID_PARAMS: the offending parameter, dotted path.

kind.description: NOT_FOUND: what was not found (chat, message, user, ...).

reason.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine-readable reason (too_old, no_rights, premium_required, blocked, ...).
